decisions.reason: The exact-font decision does not change the clean-editing requirement; message 119's separate visual-effects rule is already represented in this candidate's history.
Caption font selection is independent of caption color and text effects, whose separate message 119 changes are already represented.
Using the specified caption font does not alter narrative completeness or standalone understandability; message 119's separate narrative rule is already represented.
The caption-font correction does not change permitted source material, source exclusions, or the one-video batch constraint.
The specified-font decision does not change the existing requirement to select moments that teach a lesson.
Caption font selection has no necessary effect on the hook-selection criterion.
The font correction does not change the assigned count; the separate instruction in message 119 to redo all eight clips is already represented.
The caption-font correction does not alter the 20-to-120-second duration limits.
The font standard does not change the monthly target of 180 approved clips or its counting basis.
